scope: SDK 37 P2.1 implementation and the documented emulator matrix; remaining device gates are open

declarationGeneration.note: The strict successful export ran with the workflow fix in the working tree before its commit; the recorded generator HEAD alone predates the fix. Publish copied to local checkouts, not npm.

limitations: AVD NAT only; no Android 17 physical Wi-Fi/Ethernet, VPN, hotspot/Wi-Fi Direct, LAN IPv6 or mDNS/multicast validation.
Paho MqttClient CONNECT only; Android MqttService, full publish/subscribe, reconnect and lifecycle remain open.
No managed-profile or separate plugin-UID authorization matrix.
Final inrt target 37 full API 37 transport suite and final packaged APK remain P3 gates.
Tag-filtered logcat includes previous runs; per-run results come from instrumentation and package snapshots.
No full lint, release rebuild, remote CI, persistent target switch, plugin release or npm publication in this turn.
